output.summary: Deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. Its white flowers fade to pale pink and appear before the leaves in mid- to late spring; orange-red plums mature in late summer or early autumn. The juicy, sour fruit is eaten raw only when fully ripe or cooked, and Indigenous peoples historically dried it as a winter staple.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten raw when fully ripe or cooked in pies, preserves and jellies; Indigenous peoples historically stored it dried for winter.
